subject: AcreetionOS Update — June 23, 2026
body:
The AcreetionOS continuous integration pipeline has just been fine-tuned again, with recent changes making our release process even more reliable and efficient, and you can find all the details on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html. This is a great example of how our community-driven development process is always improving, and we're excited to see the impact it will have on our users.

Development 
The development team has been hard at work, with recent commits like the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest ISO images, which significantly boost the reliability and efficiency of our release process. You can learn more about our development process and how to get involved on our wiki page at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.

Community 
Our community has been actively discussing the latest security updates, including the recent release of Emacs 31.1 and the stable kernel set, which includes versions 7.1.10 and 6.18.46. You can stay up-to-date with the latest news and updates on our website at https://acreetionos.org/. If you're looking for tips on how to get the most out of your AcreetionOS setup, be sure to check out our documentation page at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html, where you can find guides and tutorials on a range of topics.
